title: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System - Financial Accounting - Preparation of departmental account
exam: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System
subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: When preparing departmental final accounts, common general expenses such as **rent and rates** and **building insurance** are best apportioned among departments on the basis of
options: Total sales turnover of each department
Floor area (space) occupied by each department
The number of employees working in each department
The total value of opening stock held by each department
questions.explain: Expenses that relate directly to the physical building (such as rent, rates, heating, and property insurance) are most equitably apportioned on the basis of the **floor area (space occupied)** by each department. Expenses related to sales (e.g., salesmen's commissions, discounts allowed) are apportioned based on sales turnover.
questions.exam: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System
questions.subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: A retail store operates two departments, X and Y. Total lighting and heating expenses for the year amount to ₦36,000. Department X occupies $1,200\text{ m}^2$ of floor space and Department Y occupies $600\text{ m}^2$. How much of the lighting and heating expense should be allocated to **Department X**?
questions.explain:
Apportionment is based on the floor space ratio:

1.  **Total Floor Area:** $1,200\text{ m}^2 + 600\text{ m}^2 = 1,800\text{ m}^2$
2.  **Ratio of Department X:** $\frac{1,200}{1,800} = \frac{2}{3}$
3.  **Expense for Department X:** 
    $$\text{Share} = \frac{2}{3} \times ₦36,000 = ₦24,000$$

*(Department Y receives the remaining $\frac{1}{3} \times ₦36,000 = ₦12,000$).*
